Interface SalesDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
SaleCloudDAO, SaleCSVDAO
public interface SalesDAO
Data Access Object interface for Sale entities. Defines the contract for all sale persistence operations.

  • Method Details

    • loadAllSales

      List<Sale> loadAllSales() throws PersistenceException
      Loads and returns every sale record from the backing storage. Use with caution on large datasets; prefer getClientHistory(String) when only a specific client's records are needed.
      Returns:
      a list of all Sale records; never null
      Throws:
      PersistenceException

    • isFileCreated

      boolean isFileCreated()
      Returns whether the backing persistence file exists on disk.
      Returns:
      true if the file exists, false otherwise

    • createIfNotExists

      void createIfNotExists() throws PersistenceException
      Creates the backing persistence file if it does not already exist. Implementations should initialise the file with the required structure (e.g. a CSV header).
      Throws:
      PersistenceException

    • addSale

      void addSale(Sale sale) throws PersistenceException
      Appends a new sale record to the backing storage. No existing data is loaded into memory during this operation.
      Parameters:
      sale - the Sale to persist
      Throws:
      PersistenceException

    • getClientHistory

      List<Sale> getClientHistory(String clientId) throws PersistenceException
      Returns all sale records associated with the given client ID.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the ID of the client whose history is requested
      Returns:
      a list of matching Sale records; never null
      Throws:
      PersistenceException
